title: MusicDrop v1.5.0 Available
changelog:
• Borderless Edge-to-Edge Glass Header: Removed all top borders and hard status bar padding; the theme glass gradient now paints edge-to-edge behind the status bar and camera cutout
• Seamless Theme Immersion: Status bar icons float directly on top of the glowing theme glass gradient
• Unlimited Vertical Scroll Shorts: Full-screen vertical swipe feed with infinite scroll
• Fixed Shorts Connection: Native youtube-nocookie playback with no origin mismatch
